title: Fleet scorecard
description: Is the fleet beating a pro team: merged per day and run failure share, 14 days.

options.content:
Fleet-ops#10711. Two of the six numbers have a data source today and are on this page: **merged PRs per day, products versus fleet-ops**, and **failed share of agent runs**. The failed share counts every non-success finished run, not only infra failures, because the GitHub data source has no infra-versus-test split.

No data source yet (follow-up issue): idle runners while an unblocked item waits, pushed head to review verdict, approval to merge, Claude limit per merged PR. Targets: idle 0 min/day, verdict p50 < 20 min and p90 < 60 min, infra failures < 2%, approval to merge < 15 min, products ahead of fleet-ops, Claude limit per PR cut 30%.

panels.title: Merged per day, products versus fleet-ops, last 14 days
panels.description: Target: products ahead of fleet-ops. Alert: scorecard-products-behind.

options.query: is:merged repo:Nishfleet/0509 repo:Nishfleet/aiconverter-app repo:Nishfleet/rera-report-card repo:Nishfleet/siterep-public repo:Nishfleet/tether repo:Nishfleet/TinyStudio.io-public

targets.expression:
SELECT d AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN plane = 'products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS products, SUM(CASE WHEN plane = 'fleet-ops' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fleet_ops
FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10) AS d, 'fleet-ops' AS plane FROM A UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM B) AS merged
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: Failed share of agent runs per day, last 14 days
panels.description: agent.yml and agent-dispatch.yml in fleet-ops, finished runs. Target: under 2%. Alert: scorecard-run-failure-share.

targets.expression:
SELECT d AS day, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS failed_percent
FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) AS d, conclusion FROM A UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10), conclusion FROM B) AS runs
WHERE conclusion IN ('success', 'failure', 'timed_out', 'startup_failure')
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
